newsitem.title: DENMARK: Lauritzen expects profit on ship sale.
newsitem.headline: Lauritzen expects profit on ship sale.

text.p: Danish shipping and shipbuilding group J. Lauritzen's Lauritzen Reefers unit said on Friday that it had sold two refrigeration ships and that the transaction would bring in considerable financial gains.
It said the sale was made to Finland's Helsinki-based Hollming Shipping, which in turn sold two newer refrigeration vessels to Laurizen Reefers.
The Lauritzen refrigeration ship sale was a long term charter arrangement, meaning that the vessels would not change name, it said.
"The deal is part of Lauritzen's strategy to ensure optimal performance from its refrigerator vessel fleet," it said.
Lauritzen said that the two vessels it sold were the Australian Reefer and African Reefer, totalling 644,000 cubic feet and dating from 1982 and 1985 respectively.
The two ships Lauritzen bought from Hollming, a longtime collaborator, had total 424,000 cubic footage and were built in 1992, it said.
Lauritzen said that both parties had agreed not to divulge any financial details of the deal, but that it would mean a solid financial gain for the group.
